title: Dein Kiez
summary: Neighborhood vocabulary and Berlin Kiez culture — where you live and what you like about it

blocks.title: Dein Kiez
blocks.body: *Kiez* is very Berlin — it means your **neighborhood**, but with real affection: your streets, your *Späti* (the 24-hour corner kiosk), your regulars. Every Berliner has a Kiez story. Learn to say where you live: **Ich wohne in + [Stadtteil]**, e.g. *Ich wohne in Neukölln*.

blocks.title: Berlins Kieze
blocks.body: Berlin is a patchwork of Kieze, each with its own personality: **Neukölln** — young, mixed, a Späti on every corner (that's Lena's Kiez). **Kreuzberg** — punky, multicultural, Turkish bakeries. **Prenzlauer Berg** — leafy, families, expensive coffee. **Friedrichshain** — clubs, students, graffiti. Berliners will happily debate which Kiez is best for twenty minutes.
blocks.callout: Frag einfach: 'In welchem Kiez wohnst du?'

blocks.explain: *Späti* (short for *Spätkauf*) — the beloved Berlin corner shop that never closes.

blocks.prompt: Type the German word for 'neighborhood' (the Berlin word, with feeling).
Listen and type what you hear.

lines.target: Der Späti an der Ecke ist super.
lines.en: The Späti on the corner is great.

lines.target: Mein Kiez ist laut, aber ich mag ihn.
lines.en: My neighborhood is loud, but I like it.

blocks.scene: Lena and you are walking through her neighborhood, Neukölln, on a Saturday.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.target: Das ist mein Kiez! Ich wohne hier in Neukölln.
lines.en: This is my neighborhood! I live here in Neukölln.
lines.spotlight: Kiez — Berlin-speak for neighborhood, said with real pride.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Sehr schön! Ist der Späti gut?
lines.en: Very nice! Is the Späti good?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.target: Total gut. Ich kaufe dort oft ein Bier.
lines.en: Really good. I often buy a beer there.
lines.spotlight: ein Bier — neuter, accusative, no change from nominative.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Und der Park — ist er auch hier?
lines.en: And the park — is it also here?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.target: Ja, klar! Der Park ist super für den Feierabend.
lines.en: Yes, of course! The park is great for after-work time.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Alles klar. Ich mag deinen Kiez schon jetzt.
lines.en: Got it. I already like your neighborhood.
lines.spotlight: deinen Kiez — accusative masculine again, after mögen.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.en: Glad to hear it! Welcome to Neukölln.

blocks.title: Mein Kiez
blocks.prompt: Say where you live and one thing you like about your neighborhood.
blocks.sample: Ich wohne in Neukölln. Ich mag meinen Späti.

blocks.prompt: Beschreib deinen Kiez (or your neighborhood): where you live, and one place you like (a park, a café, a Späti…).
